headline: 4-2 victory: England beats Croatia to start World Cup mission
summary: England secured a strong start to their tournament campaign with a high-scoring win over Croatia.
details: England launched their World Cup campaign with a convincing 4-2 victory over Croatia. The match was a high-scoring affair that showcased England's attacking prowess.
The game saw a dramatic start, with Croatia fighting back twice to bring the score level before the halftime break.
Despite the early setbacks and the pressure from the Croatian side, England managed to regain control and secure the win in the second half.
This victory provides England with crucial momentum as they move forward in the group stages of the tournament.

headline_marked: Budget duty hike: [[Indian fish imports nearly stop]] at Benapole port
headline: Budget duty hike: Indian fish imports nearly stop at Benapole port
summary: Increased customs duties in the new budget have led to a sharp decline in the import of fish from India through the Benapole land port.
details: The import of fish from India through the Benapole land port has almost come to a standstill following a customs duty increase in the national budget.
Traders report that the higher tariffs have made the imports financially unviable, leading to a significant drop in the volume of fish entering the country.
Benapole is one of the primary gateways for trade between Bangladesh and India, and this disruption is affecting local distributors and fish markets.
Industry stakeholders are concerned that the continued high duties will lead to a shortage of specific fish varieties in the domestic market.
caption:
Fish imports from India are drying up at Benapole port. A budget duty hike is making trade nearly impossible.

The import of fish from India through the Benapole land port has almost come to a standstill following a customs duty increase in the national budget.

Traders report that the higher tariffs have made the imports financially unviable, leading to a significant drop in the volume of fish entering the country.

Benapole is one of the primary gateways for trade between Bangladesh and India, and this disruption is affecting local distributors and fish markets.

Industry stakeholders are concerned that the continued high duties will lead to a shortage of specific fish varieties in the domestic market.
